title: Conservation Settlement
description: A conservation-law settlement of an economic/agency ledger. The core invariant: the conserved quantity is neither created nor destroyed by the settlement, i.e. sum(inflows.amount) == sum(outflows.amount) within an absolute tolerance. A non-conserving settlement MUST be rejected. Measurement, simulation, and audit only: this does not define live money movement, token issuance, redemption rights, or public-chain settlement.

conserved_quantity.description: The unit conserved across the settlement, e.g. 'value_usd', 'economic_profit', 'tokens'. Every leg is denominated in this unit.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance in the conserved unit. |sum(inflows) - sum(outflows)| must be <= tolerance for the settlement to conserve. Use 0 for exact conservation.

amount.description: Magnitude of the conserved quantity moving on this leg, denominated in conserved_quantity.
